faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the District Commissioner Hailakandi for administrative positions within the district establishment.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is District Administrative Head Assistant under the establishment of the District Commissioner Hailakandi.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the District Administrative Head Assistant post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly offline. Candidates must submit their applications through the proper channel.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed offline application form is 26 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches on time.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Senior District Administrative Assistant with at least 10 years continuous service including District Administrative Supervisory Assistant in any District Commissioner's establishment of Assam.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for the District Administrative Head Assistant?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary under PB-3 ranging from Rs. 22,000/- to 97,000/- with a Grade Pay of Rs. 10,300/-.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the application form be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted through the proper channel at the Office Chamber of the Additional District Commissioner (Personnel), O/O the District Commissioner, Hailakandi.

faq.question: Q9. What documents need to be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Applications must include details of incumbency, ACRs of the last 5 consecutive years, and 2 copies of self-attested recent passport-size colour photographs.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this position?
faq.answer: Selection will be made by the General Administration Department, Dispur as per The Assam Ministerial District Establishment Service Rules, 1967 as amended.
